subject: regular savings metro and urban
statement: A Regular Savings account at a metro or urban branch must keep an average monthly balance of ₹5,000.

subject: regular savings rural
statement: A Regular Savings account at a rural branch must keep an average monthly balance of ₹2,000.

subject: savings non-maintenance
statement: If the minimum average balance is not kept, a non-maintenance charge of ₹300 per quarter applies.

subject: savings interest
statement: Savings accounts earn interest at 3% per year, credited every quarter.

subject: own ATM transactions
statement: Savings account holders get 5 free transactions per month at Golconda Bank ATMs.

subject: other bank ATM transactions
statement: Savings account holders get 3 free transactions per month at other banks' ATMs.

subject: ATM transactions beyond free limit
statement: ATM transactions beyond the free monthly limit cost ₹21 each.

subject: cheque book
statement: The first 20 cheque leaves each year are free; additional leaves cost ₹4 per leaf.

subject: account closure
statement: Closing a savings account within 12 months of opening costs ₹500; after 12 months closure is free.

subject: SMS alerts
statement: SMS alerts cost ₹15 per quarter.

subject: basic savings account
statement: The Basic Savings account has no minimum balance and allows 4 withdrawals per month.

subject: duplicate passbook
statement: A duplicate passbook costs ₹100.

subject: classic debit card
statement: The daily ATM cash withdrawal limit on the Classic debit card is ₹40,000.

subject: classic debit card
statement: The daily limit for shop and online purchases on the Classic debit card is ₹75,000.

subject: classic debit card
statement: The Classic debit card is free in the first year and costs ₹200 per year after that.

subject: platinum debit card
statement: The daily ATM cash withdrawal limit on the Platinum debit card is ₹80,000.

subject: platinum debit card
statement: The Platinum debit card costs ₹750 per year.

subject: lost or damaged card
statement: Replacing a lost or damaged debit card costs ₹250.

subject: unauthorised transactions
statement: A customer who reports an unauthorised card transaction within 3 working days has zero liability.

subject: silver credit card
statement: The Silver credit card charges interest of 3.25% per month on any unpaid balance.

subject: silver credit card
statement: The Silver credit card has an interest-free period of up to 48 days on purchases.

subject: credit card cash advance
statement: A cash advance on a credit card costs 2.5% of the amount withdrawn, with a minimum of ₹500.

subject: international usage
statement: International usage is switched off by default on all debit cards and can be switched on in the mobile app.

subject: foreign currency transactions
statement: Card transactions in a foreign currency carry a markup of 3.5%.

subject: home loan
statement: Home loan interest rates start at 8.90% per year, on a floating rate.

subject: home loan
statement: The home loan processing fee is 0.50% of the loan amount, up to a maximum of ₹15,000.

subject: home loan
statement: A home loan can run for up to 30 years.

subject: personal loan
statement: Personal loan interest rates start at 11.50% per year.

subject: personal loan
statement: The personal loan processing fee is 2% of the loan amount.

subject: personal loan
statement: A personal loan can run for up to 5 years.

subject: personal loan prepayment
statement: Prepaying a personal loan costs 3% of the outstanding principal, and is not allowed in the first 6 months.

subject: home loan prepayment
statement: There is no prepayment charge on floating-rate home loans.

subject: missed EMI
statement: A missed or bounced EMI is charged ₹500 each time.

subject: car loan
statement: Car loan interest rates start at 9.25% per year, for a tenure of up to 7 years.

subject: account opening
statement: Opening an account needs a PAN and an Aadhaar card, or another officially valid identity and address document.

subject: re-KYC high risk
statement: Re-KYC is required every 2 years for high-risk customers.

subject: re-KYC medium risk
statement: Re-KYC is required every 8 years for medium-risk customers.

subject: re-KYC low risk
statement: Re-KYC is required every 10 years for low-risk customers.

subject: video KYC
statement: Video KYC is available from 9 am to 6 pm on bank working days.

subject: overdue re-KYC
statement: If re-KYC is overdue, the account is put on a debit freeze after 30 days' notice.

subject: change of address
statement: A customer must tell the bank about a change of address within 30 days, with proof of the new address.

subject: minor account
statement: A minor aged 10 years or older can open and operate a savings account on their own.

subject: UPI
statement: UPI transfers are limited to ₹75,000 per day.

subject: NEFT online
statement: NEFT transfers made in the mobile app or net banking are free.

subject: NEFT at branch
statement: An NEFT transfer made at a branch costs ₹15.

subject: RTGS
statement: RTGS is for transfers of ₹2,00,000 or more.

subject: IMPS
statement: An IMPS transfer costs ₹5.

subject: new beneficiary
statement: For 24 hours after a new beneficiary is added, transfers to that beneficiary are limited to ₹50,000 in total.

subject: standing instruction failure
statement: A standing instruction that fails because of low balance is charged ₹150.
